mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${col}_num IS NULL OR ${col}_den IS NULL OR ${col}_den = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(ROUND(${col}_num / ${col}_den * 100, 2), 'FM999990.00') || '%' END
mapper.select: SELECT stat_month AS month, -- 统计月份 AS emrUsageRate, -- 门诊电子病历使用率 AS standardDiagnosisRate, -- 门诊标准诊断使用率 AS onTimeRate, -- 门诊准时出诊率 AS stopRate, -- 门诊停诊率 AS chemoRecordRate, -- 门诊化疗病历记录完整率 AS chemoAdverseRate, -- 门诊化疗严重不良反应发生率 AS chemoInfusionRate, -- 门诊化疗患者静脉治疗相关不良事件发生率 AS criticalValueRate, -- 门诊危急值30分钟内通报完成率 AS bloodDrawErrorRate, -- 门诊静脉采血相关差错发生率 AS surgeryComplicationRate, -- 门诊手术并发症发生率 AS adverseEventRate -- 每千门诊诊疗人次不良事件发生率 FROM TR_QC_DTL WHERE stat_month BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} ORDER BY stat_month
